# Muhammad Mudassir Shahbaz

> Portfolio of Muhammad Mudassir Shahbaz, a full-stack web developer in Pakistan. React websites, Shopify and WooCommerce stores, WordPress sites, business automations, and AI call agents for small businesses and nonprofits.

## About

- [Portfolio home](https://www.mudassirshahbaz.me/): Full-stack web developer based in Pakistan. Founder of ORVIA.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/Mian-Mudassir12): Open-source projects and code.
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mudassir-shahbaz): Professional profile.

## Services

- Custom websites with React, Node.js, and modern JavaScript
- Shopify and WooCommerce online stores
- WordPress websites, including Elementor builds
- Business automations with n8n, Make, and Zapier
- AI call agents and chatbots for customer support

## Projects

- [Form Backend](https://form-backend-tool.vercel.app/): Form backend service for websites, built on Supabase with email and WhatsApp notifications.
- [Peace In War](https://peaceinwarclothing.com/): WooCommerce streetwear store in the United States.
- [Allied School Management System](https://alliedschool4gd.vercel.app/): School management system with attendance, fees, and reporting.
- [Sleep Heaven](https://sleep-heaven.netlify.app/): Furniture ordering website.
- [ORVIA](https://orvia-dev.vercel.app/): Web development agency website.
